name: Live Dashboard Aggregations & DB Adaptability (PostgreSQL)
objectives: Verify dashboard spend computation aggregates cost_events dynamically
Verify dashboard task counts segment correctly by status (open, inProgress, blocked, done)
Verify dashboard pending approval count matches live database state
Verify active agent status counts match current agent statuses
Verify database connection check succeeds for external PostgreSQL
Verify fallback to embedded PostgreSQL when DATABASE_URL is not set
Verify health check endpoints return accurate database connectivity and migration states
Verify auto-migrations check database schema status correctly
Ensure all dashboard metrics check company boundaries
Ensure regression verifier chain loops backward to 1.3F
